statement: TSMC's CoWoS advanced packaging is described as facing severe supply constraints amid surging AI semiconductor demand.
why: Advanced packaging is the long-lead step that caps how many accelerators can actually be built regardless of wafer starts.

impact.mechanism: Constrained CoWoS capacity lengthens the long-lead packaging step and limits accelerator output.

evidence.excerpt: TSMC's CoWoS (Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate) technology has been facing severe supply constraints amid surging AI semiconductor demand.

confidence.basis: Single secondary trade article that is more than three months old; no lead-time figure or period is stated.
